name: The Chuhn (2025)
lore:
A group of intergalactic merchants called the Chuhn have entered the galaxy to explore and trade. Their visit is temporary, and ships are encouraged to take advantage of new trading opportunities while they are passing through. The Chuhn visited once, long ago, and seem to know a few details about the galaxy's ancient history.

During The Chuhn visit, the following effects apply to the entire Galaxy:
Scrapping artifacts for Complex Tech Parts will yield additional parts.
All tariffs and auction charges have doubled.
Merchants that complete Daily Missions will earn bonus 'Star Chart Purger' artifacts.
When scanning for planets, you have a chance of receiving Complex Tech Parts based on your rank, or discovering a 'Market Interchange Beacon'.
Colonizing 'Average' or smaller planets will sometimes attract a 'Chuhn Orbital Freeport'.The 'Chuhn Ingress' Zone is available to influence.

name: Divergent Escapes (2026)
lore: The chaotic and converging movements of Synthetic and Bio-Mechanical species greatly increases tensions and conflict in the area.
additionalEffectDescription: Synesthetic medals become available during the seasonal overlap period.

name: The Streveldan Exodus
lore:
Scientists experimenting with robotic A.I. 'companions' made an unfortunate error in the bots' affection algorithms, causing these 'Q-Pedds' to rebel and flee in nearby science transport ships. The Q-Pedds took much of the related equipment with them.

Q-Pedd synthetic variants, calling themselves the 'Streveldans', are seeking to escape the region from their creators.
additionalEffectDescription:
A variety of Q-Pedd artifacts will now appear in standard artifact shipments
Colonizing planets will sometimes attract Streveldan Colonists looking for a place to land

name: The Lepus Cluster
lore: Colonies near the Lepus Cluster have reported sightings of strange Bio-Mechanical entities, along with a message from their creators.

name: Cycle of Fools (2026)
lore: During this part of the cycle, many ships deploy mischievous holographic disguises as they venture through the galaxy...

name: Galactic Civicordium (2026)
lore:
The Civicordium is an interstellar organization that provides a forum for governments to coordinate, establish agreements, and maintain diplomatic relations.

During these cycles, special envoys are dispatched to expand participation and bring forward new matters for assembly.
additionalEffectDescription:
Influence costs for Galactic Voting reduced by 20%.
Influence costs to Convene the Galactic Council reduced by 9%.
Energy costs to influence Zones reduced by 30%.

name: Growth Consensus (2026)
lore: With biological systems in genetic flux around the Galaxy, The Civicordium weighs on the new opportunities and crises that result
additionalEffectDescription: Synesthetic medals become available during the seasonal overlap period.

name: Genoform Surge (2026)
lore: An unusual spacial rupture opens near Drannox, causing species across the Galaxy to evolve and mutate far more rapidly than usual. An entity of unknown origin stands guard at its aperture.
additionalEffectDescription: When growing Evolution Genes, you will earn 30% more than usual.

name: Spectral Convergence (2026)
img: Spectral ConvergenceJun 4 - 30
additionalEffectDescription: Various features from other Seasonal Events will randomly appear (and disappear) each day.
lore: An unusual cosmic phenomenon causes light across the galaxy to refract and bend across time, revealing fragments of reality from the past and future. Spacefaring civilizations everywhere celebrate the convergence as a tribute to the galaxy's shared diversity.
